Dr Jason Roberts
Gastroenterology
Newtown Hospital
11 High Street
Newtwon

10-06-2010
Dear Dr Robets,
RE: Ms Anne Hall D.O.B.: 19-09-1965
I am writing to refer Ms Hail, a 35-year-old patient whose features are suggestive of gastro-oesophageal reflux versus oesophageal stricture. Your further evaluation and investigation would be appreciated.
Ms Hail is a non-smoker, a social drinker and overweight ( BMI 28.2). It is worth mentioning that she has a history of allergy to codeine, dust mites and sulphur dioxide. She has a strong family history of peptic ulcer, asthma, hypertention and heart disease.
Regarding Ms Hall medical history, she has been suffering of dyspepsia since 2004. She also has been complaining of dermatitis for which she has been commenced on corticosteroids for 4 years.
On today's review, Ms Hall presented with dysphagia which started 2 weeks ago following prescription of unknown chinese herbal product. The dysphagia was associated with epigastric pain radiating to the back at the level of T12. Moreover, she reported increased  coffee drinking as well as infrequent intake of aspirin.
In view of the above, I would be grateful if you could provide a consultation for Mr Hall and advice regarding the further investigations including endoscopy to confirm the diagnosis.
For any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Yours sincerely,
Doctor
